item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli tanks have crossed the Yellow Line into central Gaza and launched a ground operation, while an airstrike on Nasser Hospital killed six Palestinians. In the West Bank, Israeli settlers shot a 72‑year-old Palestinian woman near a new outpost and the IDF mistakenly demolished a Palestinian home in violation of a Supreme Court order. Israel delayed building contracts for a West Bank settlement after UK sanctions on construction firms and used a video of swimming in Gaza to downplay civilian hardships. The International Court of Justice ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya is being cited as potentially relevant to Israel's genocide defence. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:
